**COGNNA** is redefining modern cybersecurity with Nexus, our Agentic AI SOC platform, and our Smart MDR services. We help organizations across the region and around the world cut alert noise, respond to incidents faster and stay compliant with frameworks such as SAMA, NCA, ISO 27001 and PCI DSS.

Behind it all: AI-driven triage, deep automation and our elite 24/7 Guardians Team, delivering unified visibility and rapid threat containment across endpoint, cloud and network.

As our **DevOps Engineer Intern**, you will learn by doing. You'll work alongside senior engineers to provision multi-cloud infrastructure, keep Kubernetes environments healthy, configure GitOps pipelines and support cloud security operations.

This is not a shadow-only internship. From your first weeks, your automation, documentation and troubleshooting will directly improve the reliability of the platform our customers rely on.

### Responsibilities

### 1\. Cloud operations (GCP & Alibaba Cloud)

* Provision infrastructure: help provision and maintain cloud resources following cost-efficiency and security best practices.
* Keep IAM clean: review access requests, update role definitions and manage service-account hygiene under guidance.
* Watch costs: track utilization, spot unused or over-provisioned resources, filter logs and set up budget alerts.
* Learn the network: navigate VPCs, firewall rules and private connectivity; support routine security patching and Vanta compliance tasks.

### 2\. Kubernetes & containers (GKE)

* Monitor cluster health: track status, resource usage and reliability metrics across development and staging clusters.
* Troubleshoot: help investigate pod scheduling issues, container crashes and resource bottlenecks.
* Partner with developers: learn and share containerization best practices, from Dockerfiles to multi-stage builds.
* Shadow upgrades: join senior engineers during Kubernetes upgrades and maintenance windows.

### 3\. CI/CD (ArgoCD & GitHub Actions)

* Onboard services to GitOps: draft ArgoCD Application manifests, sync policies and environment configurations.
* Catch drift: monitor ArgoCD for out-of-sync applications and flag them to the team.
* Improve pipelines: integrate security scanners, linters and tests into GitHub Actions workflows.

### 4\. Infrastructure as Code (Terraform)

* Shadow migrations: learn how complex manual infrastructure is moved into code.
* Write modules: build and maintain modular Terraform that brings unmanaged resources under version control.

### 5\. Security & access operations

* Manage access: handle developer SSH access, VPN profiles and environment credentials with full audit logging.
* Harden the baseline: apply infrastructure hardening guidelines with our Security Engineers and join security reviews.
* Support the Guardians: provide infrastructure logs and environment details during security investigations.

### 6\. Monitoring, alerting & automation

* Build dashboards: create and update Grafana and Cloud Monitoring dashboards for real-time visibility.
* Write runbooks: draft and maintain runbooks and SOPs for common operational tasks, with mentor feedback.
* Automate the toil: spot repetitive manual work and replace it with Bash or Python scripts and automated workflows.

**Requirements**

You don't need to know it all yet. You need solid foundations and a real appetite to learn.

* Currently pursuing, or recently completed, a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Cybersecurity or a related field.
* A basic understanding of cloud computing concepts (GCP, AWS or Alibaba Cloud).
* Comfort on the Linux command line and basic scripting in Bash or Python.
* Foundational knowledge of containers and Docker.
* A grasp of core networking: IP subnets, DNS, HTTP/S, firewalls and VPNs.
* Eagerness to learn GitOps, Kubernetes and Infrastructure as Code with Terraform.

### Bonus points

* Exposure to Kubernetes, even through local tools like Minikube, Kind or k3s.
* Some familiarity with CI/CD tools such as GitHub Actions, GitLab CI or Jenkins.
* Early experience with Terraform or infrastructure scripting.
* Hands-on work from university projects, open-source contributions or a personal home lab.

**Benefits**

* **Accelerated learning:** work hands-on in production multi-cloud environments (GCP and Alibaba Cloud), GKE, ArgoCD and modern GitOps workflows.
* **Direct mentorship:** learn side by side with experienced engineers committed to your growth.
* **Cutting-edge security tech:** see firsthand how infrastructure powers Cognna Nexus, our flagship AI SOC platform.
* **Collaborative culture:** join a team that values curiosity, proactive problem-solving and continuous improvement.

we are  seeking a **Systems Integration Engineer** to help design, modernize, and sustain integrations for a **mission-critical, globally deployed identity and mobility platform**. You will work on both **standards-based** and **custom integrations** spanning external data providers, identity and verification services, biometric and peripheral devices, access-control systems, and country- or customer-specific third-party platforms. The environment ranges from **low-power edge clusters in austere locations** to **large, centralized deployments** to **cloud-forward AWS architectures**.

This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys solving hard interoperability problems, modernizing legacy interfaces, and building resilient integrations that operate reliably under real-world network, performance, and operational constraints.

**What you will do**

* Design, build, and maintain secure, reliable integrations between a distributed platform and third-party systems using **REST APIs, asynchronous messaging, secure file/data exchange, and device/peripheral interfaces**
* Modernize legacy integrations into **Java-based microservices** running in a distributed platform architecture
* Build integrations across **edge, data center, and AWS cloud** deployment models
* Engineer for **resilience, observability, auditability, latency, and intermittent/low-bandwidth network conditions**
* Integrate with government and commercial systems such as identity and verification services, traveler data platforms, biometric and document-capture peripherals, and access-control and gate systems

Our AI Native Engineering team builds software for Scopely game teams and internal departments: tools that use large language models (LLMs) for bug triage, player feedback analysis, market and company research, and contract analytics, alongside direct-to-consumer web stores for Scopely games. Most of these tools repeat one pattern: connect a source system, build a trusted store, put an LLM or governed logic over it, and control who can see what. Today each product builds that pattern its own way, with its own model setup, its own access rules, and its own safety controls.

Build MCP tool servers that expose company data to agents and chat tools, with the end user's permissions enforced before any data reaches the model
Help introduce relationship-based access control across products, so access rules are defined once and applied to both database queries and vector search

Tata Consultancy Services (TCS) is an IT services, consulting and business solutions organization that has been partnering with many of the world’s largest businesses in their transformation journeys for over 50 years. TCS offers a consulting-led, cognitive powered, integrated portfolio of business, technology and engineering services and solutions. This is delivered through its unique Location Independent Agile™ delivery model, recognized as a benchmark of excellence in software development.
A part of the Tata group, India's largest multinational business group, TCS has over 616,171 of the world’s best-trained consultants with 157 nationalities in 53 countries. For more information, visit www.tcs.com and follow TCS news at @TCS_News.

Job Description:

Role Overview:

The organization is seeking a hands-on Senior Software Engineer to lead the development, integration, and ongoing enhancement of enterprise software and AI-powered applications across Front, Middle, and Back Office functions.
This position represents a foundational hire in building the organization’s internal software engineering capability, with the objective of progressively transitioning from vendor-led development to internally owned and delivered digital products.
The successful candidate will initially work closely with external technology partners to review, inherit, and enhance existing solutions while independently developing new applications. The role combines strong software engineering expertise with cloud-native development (Google Cloud), DevOps practices, and exposure to AI technologies.

Key Responsibilities:

1. Software & AI Product Engineering:

• Design, develop, test, and maintain enterprise applications, digital products, APIs, and backend services.
• Build end-to-end applications, including backend, frontend, database, and system integrations.
• Develop and integrate AI-powered capabilities, including LLM applications, AI agents, and intelligent automation.
• Translate business requirements into scalable, secure, production-ready solutions.
• Support digital product development across trading, risk management, operations, finance, and corporate functions.

2. Vendor Transition & Technical Ownership:

• Review, assess, and take ownership of source code and applications developed by external vendors.
• Lead technical knowledge transfer, code handovers, and transition of vendor-developed solutions to internal ownership.
• Evaluate code quality, architecture, security, maintainability, and technical documentation.
• Independently troubleshoot, enhance, and extend inherited applications.
• Establish reusable components, development standards, and engineering practices to reduce long-term reliance on external vendors.

3. Cloud Engineering & DevOps:

• Develop, deploy, and maintain applications on Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
• Implement and manage CI/CD pipelines, version control, automated testing, and release processes.
• Manage application deployments across development, testing, and production environments.
• Implement application monitoring, logging, troubleshooting, and performance optimization.
• Collaborate with the existing GCP administrator on cloud infrastructure, security, access management, and deployment environments.

4. Internal Engineering Capability Development:

• Help establish the internal software development practices, coding standards, documentation, and technical architecture.
• Contribute to technology selection, engineering frameworks, and reusable development accelerators.
• Support the evolution of internal software engineering capabilities, including onboarding and mentoring future developers.
• Work closely with AI engineers, data scientists, product owners, business teams, and third-party vendors to deliver enterprise-grade solutions.

Required Qualifications & Experience:

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
• 10+ years of hands-on software development experience, including experience delivering production applications.
• Strong proficiency in Python and backend development frameworks such as FastAPI or Django.
• Experience in frontend development using React, TypeScript, JavaScript, or equivalent technologies.
• Strong understanding of software architecture, REST APIs, databases (SQL/NoSQL), application integration, and security.
• Hands-on experience with GCP services, particularly Cloud Run, Cloud Build, Cloud Storage, and related application development services.
• Experience with Git, Docker, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and application deployment.
• Demonstrated ability to independently design, develop, troubleshoot, and maintain production-grade applications.
• Experience working with third-party developers, reviewing code, or taking ownership of externally developed software.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Experience with Vertex AI, Gemini APIs, LLM applications, RAG architectures, and AI agents.
• Familiarity with Terraform, Kubernetes, and Infrastructure as Code.
• Experience with data engineering, enterprise integrations, event-driven architectures, and cloud-native microservices.
• Exposure to commodity trading, energy markets, financial services, or enterprise trading and risk management systems.
• Experience building engineering capabilities, defining development standards, or mentoring junior developers.

Application Deadline: 30-November-2026

About The Role

We are seeking a Member of Technical Staff to join our Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) team. In this customer-facing role, you will work directly with strategic partners and customers as part of the FDE team to enable, optimize, and deploy state-of-the-art GenAI inference workloads on AMD data center CPUs and GPUs (Instinct™ family). Responsibilities

Partner with customers as part of the FDE team to enable and optimize large language models (LLMs) and multimodal models on AMD Instinct GPUs, meeting committed performance and accuracy targets.
Optimize GenAI inference pipelines on vLLM and SGLang, including PD disaggregation, expert parallelism (EP/wide-EP), tensor/data parallelism, speculative decoding, and KV cache management.
Develop and tune low-level GPU kernels (Triton, HIP, composable kernels) for attention, MoE, GEMM, quantization, and normalization operations.
Profile end-to-end workloads, identify bottlenecks across GPU/CPU boundaries, and deliver measurable throughput and latency improvements versus competitive targets.
Enable advanced data types and techniques (FP8, MXFP4, sparse attention) with a focus on both performance and numerical accuracy.
Debug complex runtime, stability, and accuracy issues in production environments; partner with core engineering teams to identify root causes and contribute fixes.
Contribute optimizations back to open-source frameworks (vLLM, SGLang, ATOM, AITER) and internal libraries; document best practices and deliver production-ready artifacts to customers.
Leverage AI-assisted coding tools and agentic workflows to accelerate development, debugging, optimization, and code review across the inference stack.

BS, MS, or PhD in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field, along with 8+ years of relevant experience.
Solid expertise in GPU architecture and performance optimization, including hands-on experience with AMD ROCm (or CUDA) and GPU kernel development.

Experience with AI-assisted coding and agentic development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude, Cursor, or equivalent) to enhance productivity in kernel development, large-scale codebase navigation, debugging, and framework integration.
Experience working with LLM inference frameworks (vLLM, SGLang, or equivalent) and serving optimization techniques.
Solid understanding of transformer and MoE architectures, quantization, and distributed inference strategies (TP, DP, EP, and related parallelism techniques).
Proficiency with profiling and debugging tools (e.g., rocProfiler, ROCdebug-agent).


Nice to Have

Experience optimizing frontier models (DeepSeek, Qwen, Kimi, MiniMax, GLM, etc.) in production environments.
Track record of contributing to open-source AI inference frameworks.
Experience integrating AI-driven automation into engineering workflows and developer tooling.
Strong customer-facing communication skills and the ability to manage technical deliverables against committed timelines.

About Noon Academy: 
Noon is a Saudi EdTech company. Noon Track runs inside schools: a hybrid programme that prepares students for Qudrat (قدرات) and Tahsili (تحصيلي), the national university-admission exams. Our students are 15 to 17 years old. Noon is becoming an AI-native company, department by department, and the number of schools we serve is growing. We believe every student deserves world-class teachers. And to make it happen, we’re reimagining everything about education: from cutting-edge tech to peer learning and physical spaces that spark curiosity.

Hear about our vision directly from our CEO here.
Learn more about us [here]

The role
You will be the one designer who owns the student experience. Primarily that means the student app: where students study, work with an AI tutor, answer questions, and take part in activities, including games and head-to-head duels on a topic. You will also shape parts of the live classroom experience.

This is a Senior/Principal-level individual contributor Product Designer role. There is no design team underneath you and no manager drawing your roadmap. You take a problem from the first student conversation to the shipped screen, and you decide what to look at next.

Why this role
One owner of the whole student experience, with a direct line to leadership.
Speed: with AI in the workflow, ideas go from research to release in days, not quarters.
An experimentation practice being built from the ground up, with you shaping it.
A company expanding into more schools, with a long-term ambition to match.

What You Will Do

Spend real time with students in Saudi schools. Interviews, focus groups, classroom observation. Turn what you hear into design decisions, and go back to check them.
Design for Saudi Arabia, not for the generic "best practice" app. Patterns that work in London or San Francisco often fail here. You know why, and you can show it in your work.
Own the student app end to end. Flows, information architecture, prototypes, final UI, and the handover to engineering.
Design activities students want to come back to, games and duels included, with learning as the gate: an activity that is more fun but teaches less is a regression.
Run experiments. State a hypothesis, build the variants, agree the metric, and read the result honestly. You will help build the experimentation practice, not just use it.
Work AI-native. Use AI tools for generation, prototyping and production so your time goes to research and judgement. We care about the quality of your decisions, not how many pixels you pushed by hand.
Work directly with the product manager and engineers. Short loops, fast releases, no layers.

About you (To be successful in this role, you should have):

Roughly 5 years of experience in UX, product design experience. We care less about the number and more about how many people you have interviewed and what you did with it.
A research practice you can describe in detail: how you recruit, what you ask, how you synthesise, how it reached the product.
A portfolio of projects that demonstrate your creativity and delivery of results through great consumer-facing mobile-first experiences
Proficiency in using various tools and techniques to create and communicate your design ideas, such as sketches, wireframes, mockups, prototypes, etc.
Experience in conducting user research and testing in different contexts and cultures, using both qualitative and quantitative methods
A strong sense of empathy, curiosity, and creativity, and a willingness to learn and experiment

Nice to have:
Game design or gaming industry experience.
Large-scale B2C or e-commerce experience, where A/B tests and small-metric optimisation were the daily rhythm.
Enough front-end to prototype in code with AI assistance.

Why Noon?

Real impact — your work directly affects how thousands of students learn every day.
Speed and autonomy — small team, big problems, zero bureaucracy.
AI-native culture — we don't just talk about AI, we build with it daily.
Well-funded — Series B closed, substantial recurring revenue, and accelerating.
Mission that matters — every student deserves world-class teachers. We're making it happen.

Benefits
In addition to a competitive base salary, we offer:

Performance-based bonus
21 days of annual leave
Full premium Medical coverage, including Family Dependent

Job title: Senior QA Engineer – Manual Testing & Application Monitoring

Job Location: Jeddah, Saudi Arabia

1. Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced Senior Technical QA Analyst to ensure the functional quality, technical stability and reliability of our digital eCommerce platforms. The role combines hands-on manual testing, API and integration testing, production application monitoring and technical incident investigation.

The candidate will identify functional defects, monitor application errors using Sentry or equivalent observability tools, investigate customer-facing issues and coordinate with internal technology teams and external development vendors. This is not a purely functional manual testing position.

2. Key Responsibilities

A. Functional & Manual Testing
• Develop and execute functional, regression, integration and end-to-end test cases.
• Validate web customer journeys including registration, quotation, checkout, payment and post-purchase transactions.
• Perform browser compatibility, responsive design and mobile web testing.
• Review requirements, UX designs and acceptance criteria for test coverage.
• Document, prioritize and track defects; conduct smoke testing, UAT support and release validation.

B. Application Observability, Monitoring & Production Quality
• Operate application monitoring and observability platforms; investigate production issues across browser, application, API and infrastructure signals.
• Monitor frontend/backend exceptions, failed transactions, API availability, latency, slow page loads, user-impacting errors and performance regressions.
• Correlate stack traces, logs, browser console/network evidence, distributed traces, session replay, release changes and service health to investigate incidents.
• Analyze recurring issues, severity, frequency and customer-journey impact.
• Maintain monitoring dashboards, alerts, thresholds, incident classifications and escalation playbooks; coordinate with IT/vendors on instrumentation gaps.
• Monitor release health and verify resolution of production issues.

C. API & Integration Testing
• Test REST APIs with Postman or equivalent tools, including payloads, authentication and error handling.
• Investigate HTTP errors, timeouts and integration defects.
• Validate integrations among the eCommerce platform, payment gateways, core systems and third-party services.

D. Technical Quality & Incident Management
• Serve as a technical quality contact between business, IT and development vendors.
• Reproduce incidents, provide evidence-backed defect reports and verify fixes.
• Track defect recurrence and release quality; prioritize issues by customer and business impact.

E. Reporting & Continuous Improvement
• Maintain QA execution, defect and application stability reports.
• Track error rates, failed transactions, critical defects, incident recurrence and resolution time.
• Recommend improvements in monitoring coverage, test processes and release quality.

Monitoring & Diagnostic Tool Landscape (examples, not an exhaustive checklist)
• Application error tracking & APM: Sentry, Datadog APM/RUM, New Relic, Dynatrace, Cisco AppDynamics, Elastic Observability, Azure Application Insights, AWS CloudWatch / X-Ray.
• Logs, metrics & infrastructure observability: Grafana, Prometheus, Loki, Elasticsearch / Kibana (ELK), Splunk, OpenSearch, CloudWatch Logs, Azure Monitor.
• Real-user monitoring & session diagnostics: Datadog RUM, New Relic Browser, Dynatrace Digital Experience Monitoring, Sentry Session Replay, LogRocket, FullStory; browser DevTools.
• Synthetic monitoring & availability: Checkly, Pingdom, UptimeRobot, Datadog Synthetic Monitoring, New Relic Synthetics, Grafana Synthetic Monitoring.
• API, network & test diagnostics: Postman, Swagger/OpenAPI, Chrome DevTools, Charles Proxy or Fiddler; Jira/Azure DevOps for incident and defect tracking.
• Candidates need not know every listed product. Require demonstrated depth in at least one observability/APM platform, strong web/API debugging and the ability to learn the organization's chosen stack.

3. Required Qualifications & Experience

Mandatory Requirements
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, IT or related discipline.
• 4–6+ years in software QA with strong manual web application testing.
• Practical API testing experience using Postman or equivalent.
• Strong knowledge of HTTP, JSON, REST APIs and client-server architecture.
• Proficiency in browser DevTools (Console and Network), JavaScript error investigation and API troubleshooting.
• Experience with Jira, Azure DevOps or equivalent defect/test management tools.
• Experience with complex transactional web applications and engineering/vendor collaboration.

Highly Preferred
• Hands-on production use of at least one application observability/APM platform (e.g., Sentry, Datadog, New Relic, Dynatrace, Elastic Observability, Grafana stack, AppDynamics, Azure Application Insights or AWS CloudWatch).
• Production application support and customer-facing incident investigation.
• Experience interpreting application logs, metrics, traces, exception stack traces, API latency, release health and user-impacting performance signals.
• eCommerce, fintech, banking or insurance platform experience.

Additional Advantages
• Basic JavaScript or TypeScript; SQL; Playwright, Cypress or Selenium.
• Familiarity with GA4, Hotjar, CI/CD and agile delivery; ISTQB certification.

4. Expected Deliverables

Outputs
• Functional, regression and end-to-end test cases and execution reports.
• Defect register with reproducible steps and technical evidence.
• Application monitoring dashboards, alert configurations and stability reports across the selected observability platform(s).
• Incident investigation reports and API/integration testing results.
• Release readiness, post-deployment validation and quality improvement recommendations.

5. Key Performance Indicators

KPIs
• Test coverage and execution completion; critical defects escaping into production.
• Time to detect and escalate production issues; monitoring and alert coverage.
• Defect investigation and validation turnaround; recurring defect rate.
• Release validation effectiveness and incident documentation quality.

6. Ideal Candidate Profile
• Technically strong QA professional experienced in complex web applications and live production environments.
• Comfortable interpreting errors and logs, troubleshooting independently and coordinating engineering fixes.
• Experience beyond executing predefined manual test cases is essential.

Are you a seasoned full stack developer passionate about building scalable applications and solving complex engineering challenges? This opportunity allows you to contribute to innovative digital solutions transforming how utility companies plan, manage, and optimize their field operations. You will work on a cloud-native platform combining workflow automation, operational management, digital twin technology, and AI-powered planning capabilities.

Using

React, Node.js, NestJS, PostgreSQL, and AWS, you will develop end-to-end features that deliver tangible value to real-world infrastructure operations. You will take ownership of features from initial design through production deployment while contributing to architectural decisions and platform reliability. Working remotely with experienced engineers and an international team, including UK-based stakeholders, you will have the opportunity to influence product development and adopt modern AI-assisted engineering practices.

Accountabilities

• Develop modern frontend applications: Design, build, and maintain responsive, scalable, and user-friendly React applications that support operational planning, scheduling, and management workflows.

• Build robust backend services: Develop and maintain scalable backend services and REST APIs using Node.js and NestJS, ensuring performance, security, and maintainability.

• Deliver end-to-end features: Take ownership of full stack functionality from requirements analysis and technical design through implementation, testing, deployment, and ongoing maintenance.

• Design and optimize databases: Develop and maintain PostgreSQL schemas, optimize queries, and ensure efficient data management and reliable application performance.

• Implement cloud-native solutions: Deploy, operate, and support applications on AWS, leveraging relevant services and infrastructure to build scalable and resilient systems.

• Contribute to technical architecture: Participate in architectural discussions, recommend effective technical solutions, review code, and help establish engineering standards and best practices.

• Maintain software quality: Implement appropriate testing strategies, participate in code reviews, support release activities, and contribute to continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) processes.

• Troubleshoot and improve reliability: Investigate production incidents, identify root causes, resolve technical issues, and proactively improve platform stability, performance, and scalability.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams: Work closely with product managers, designers, engineers, and UK-based stakeholders to translate business requirements into practical technical solutions.

• Drive independent problem-solving: Analyze complex technical challenges, evaluate alternatives, and deliver solutions with minimal supervision.

• Leverage AI-assisted development: Use modern development tools, including Cursor and Claude Code, to accelerate implementation, improve productivity, and support efficient software engineering workflows.

Requirements

• Professional experience: At least 7 years of commercial Node.js development experience, with a strong focus on backend engineering and building production-grade applications.

• Frontend expertise: Solid commercial experience with React and the ability to develop and maintain modern, scalable frontend applications.

• Backend development: Strong knowledge of Node.js, hands-on experience with NestJS, and demonstrated expertise in designing, implementing, and maintaining REST APIs and backend services.

• Database proficiency: Strong knowledge of PostgreSQL, including database design, query optimization, and efficient data access patterns.

• Cloud computing: Practical experience with AWS services, particularly Lambda, ECS, API Gateway, and related cloud infrastructure.

• Software engineering practices: Good understanding of software testing, Git workflows, code reviews, CI/CD pipelines, and modern development methodologies.

• Analytical and problem-solving skills: Ability to investigate complex technical issues, identify root causes, make sound engineering decisions, and deliver effective solutions independently.

Job Title:

Junior Software Engineer (KSA-Based, Preferably an Arabic Speaker)

About Insight360:

Insight360 is a forward-thinking consultancy and implementation firm at the forefront of AI and data analytics. With a rich portfolio of over 100 successful projects spanning various industries and global locations, we specialize in guiding organizations towards Smart Decision Support Systems. Our mission is to equip decision-makers with intelligent insights, leveraging a robust methodology that seamlessly integrates data analytics with overarching business strategies and objectives. Renowned for our unwavering commitment to delivering tangible business value, we employ cutting-edge technologies and tools, earning us the esteemed reputation of being a trusted partner in the industry.

THE ROLE

You write production code from your first sprint. You will build the services, APIs, and interfaces that run inside enterprise systems across the UAE and GCC — under the review of architects who read every line, and to engineering standards you will be held to rather than eased into.

We hire juniors for trajectory, not inventory. A long tool list on a CV counts for less than a small thing you built well and can defend under questioning. You will use AI-assisted development tools as a daily instrument and be expected to move fast with them — but speed without judgement is a defect, and you own every line you ship regardless of who or what wrote it.

WHAT YOU'LL DO
• Build and ship features in production services — REST endpoints, backend services, and front-end interfaces — under architect review and to a defined definition of done.
• Write tests as part of the work, not after it — unit and integration tests that a reviewer trusts. Untested code is unfinished code.
• Work in a Git-based pull request workflow — branch, commit cleanly, raise reviewable PRs, respond to code review without ego, and keep CI green.
• Integrate external APIs and data sources — authentication, pagination, retries, rate limits, and failure handling that does not fall over in production.
• Debug across the stack — reproduce, read logs and traces, isolate the root cause, and fix the cause rather than the symptom.
• Use AI-assisted development environments (Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot) to accelerate delivery — then review, test, and explain what they produced.
• Document what you build — clear READMEs, API contracts, and honest commit and PR descriptions your teammates can work from.
• Participate in design discussions — ask why a design was chosen, propose alternatives, and learn to argue trade-offs rather than preferences.

MUST-HAVE: ENGINEERING FOUNDATION

Programming. Strong Python — clean, readable, tested code; functions and classes, error handling, packages and virtual environments. Equivalent strength in another language plus demonstrable ability to become productive in Python quickly is acceptable.

APIs & Web Services. REST fundamentals and the ability to build an endpoint end to end (FastAPI, Flask, Django, or Node/Express). HTTP semantics, JSON, status codes, and authentication basics.

Front-End. TypeScript/JavaScript and one modern framework — Angular preferred, React acceptable — with solid HTML and CSS. You should be able to put a working interface in front of a service you built.

Databases. SQL that goes beyond SELECT * — joins, aggregation, indexing basics, and sane schema design. PostgreSQL or SQL Server experience preferred.

Version Control & Tooling. Git in daily use (branching, pull requests, resolving merge conflicts), plus fluency in VS Code or Visual Studio and comfort on the command line.

Computer Science Fundamentals. Data structures, algorithmic complexity, object-oriented design, exception handling, and a working understanding of asynchronous execution and concurrency.

Testing. Hands-on with a unit testing framework (pytest, Jest, or equivalent) and able to say what separates a useful test from a decorative one.

AI-Native Development. You already build with AI coding assistants and can explain, line by line, what the tool produced and why it is correct. The AI wrote it is never an explanation for a defect.

GOOD TO HAVE — SIGNALS OF TRAJECTORY
• Docker fundamentals, or a CI/CD pipeline (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions) you set up yourself rather than inherited.
• Cloud exposure — Azure preferred; AWS or GCP equally welcome as evidence you can operate beyond localhost.
• Calling an LLM API from your own code (Anthropic, OpenAI, or open-source models) — a working prototype you can walk us through counts for more than a certificate.
• Message queues, caching (Redis), or any experience with systems that must stay up under load.
• Open-source contributions, side projects, hackathons, or competitive programming — anything that shows you write code when nobody is grading you.

HOW WE ASSESS

We will not ask you to invert a binary tree on a whiteboard. We will ask you to think in front of us.
• Code you can defend. Bring something you built. We will ask why you made each decision, not what the code does.
• Debugging under observation. We give you a broken thing. Your reasoning process matters more than your speed.
• Judgement under acceleration. You will use an AI assistant in the exercise. We are watching for whether you can tell when its output is right, when it is subtly wrong, and when it should be thrown away.
• Learning velocity. What did you learn in the last six months, how did you learn it, and what did you build with it
• Communication. Explain one technical decision to someone who is not an engineer. Clients will ask you to do this for real.

QUALIFICATIONS
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related engineering or quantitative discipline.
• 1–3 years of professional software engineering experience. Strong internships, academic projects, or a substantial personal portfolio are considered for candidates at the lower end of that range.
• Professional working proficiency in English.

What We Value

We seek people who are:
• Ambitious, curious, and creative.
• Sincere and joyful in how they work.
• Passionate about delivering impact and creating value.
• Committed to integrity, excellence, and continuous improvement.
• Disciplined in execution, but flexible in learning.

How to Apply

Interested candidates are invited to apply (all steps are mandatory):
• Apply on this job post on Linkedin.
• Fill the self screening form https://links.insight360.ae/Junior-Software-Engineer
• Send your CV and portfolio to: [HIDDEN TEXT] with the subject line: Junior Software Engineer Application - UAE [Your Name]
